description: Reusable statistic sets (Sheet 2 'Statistic set classes') — terminology-layer groupings of statistic terms. Each set bundles terms from statistics_vocabulary.json. Cited by BOTH method-side output_class_templates (statistics_set[]) and AC concept-side result patterns; owned by neither.

hypothesis_test_F_distribution.name: F-distribution hypothesis test
hypothesis_test_F_distribution.label: F-test
hypothesis_test_F_distribution.description: Test statistics for an F-distributed omnibus/term test.

hypothesis_test_t_distribution.name: t-distribution hypothesis test
hypothesis_test_t_distribution.label: t-test
hypothesis_test_t_distribution.description: Test statistics for a t-distributed test.

hypothesis_test_chi_squared.name: Chi-squared hypothesis test
hypothesis_test_chi_squared.label: Chi-squared test
hypothesis_test_chi_squared.description: Test statistics for a chi-squared test.

hypothesis_test_normal.name: Normal (z) hypothesis test
hypothesis_test_normal.label: z-test
hypothesis_test_normal.description: Test statistics for a normal-approximation (z) test.

ci_estimate.name: Estimate with confidence interval
ci_estimate.label: Estimate + CI
ci_estimate.description: A point estimate with its confidence interval bounds.

ci_estimate_normal.name: Estimate with CI and SE (normal)
ci_estimate_normal.label: Estimate + CI + SE
ci_estimate_normal.description: Point estimate, CI bounds and standard error (normal-based inference).

ci_estimate_t_distribution.name: Estimate with CI, SE and df (t)
ci_estimate_t_distribution.label: Estimate + CI + SE + df
ci_estimate_t_distribution.description: Point estimate, CI bounds, standard error and degrees of freedom (t-based inference).

point_estimate_SE.name: Estimate with SE
point_estimate_SE.label: Estimate + SE
point_estimate_SE.description: A point estimate with its standard error.

proportion_estimate.name: Proportion estimate
proportion_estimate.label: Proportion
proportion_estimate.description: A proportion expressed as numerator/denominator with proportion and percentage.
